issues.source_quote: Просит ... Бабу Ягу со стороны брать не будем, воспитаем в своём коллективе! - Попытаемся.
issues.translation_quote: We won’t bring in a witch from outside — we’ll train one in-house.
issues.justification: Em dash and curly apostrophes are inconsistent with the rest of the text's typography; also 'train' slightly changes 'воспитаем' (raise/rear), losing the humorous upbringing angle.

issues.source_quote: Выходит докладчик! - Докладчик? - Да! И так коротенько
issues.translation_quote: And so: Briefly, about forty minutes, I don’t think we need any more than that… he delivers his talk.
issues.justification: Punctuation and capitalization are awkward and break the spoken rhythm; 'And so: Briefly' is stilted.

issues.source_quote: Прошу всех взглянуть на небо ... вооружённым глазом ... лучше всего, конечно, пять звёздочек!
issues.translation_quote: [The best cognac in USSR was known as 5*]
issues.justification: An editorial bracketed gloss was inserted into the subtitle text, which is not subtitle material. Also 'aided eye' is a stilted rendering of 'вооружённым глазом' (naked vs. armed eye); 'Peo-ple! ... hellooo!' and 'Assa' are rendered unnaturally.
